description: 3-4 Day Bounce — weak bounce after pullback, short entry
notes: 14 examples (REAL removed - different setup profile). 18 scan conditions. Full market scan with 5M dollar volume floor produces 2 A+ results (BE, THAR) on 2026-02-19.

scan_conditions.name: close_extended_above_sma50
scan_conditions.description: Close at least 0.3 ATR above 50 SMA

scan_conditions.name: two_of_three_up_closes
scan_conditions.description: At least 2 of last 3 days closed higher than prior day

scan_conditions.name: off_the_low
scan_conditions.description: 3-day low is below 2-day low (pullback low at least 3 bars ago)
exceptions: REAL (MINL3 = MINL2, low was exactly 2 bars ago)

scan_conditions.name: bounced_from_low
scan_conditions.description: Close at least 0.8 ATR above 10-day low

scan_conditions.name: below_prior_high
scan_conditions.description: Price at least 1.0 ATR below 15-day high (clear rejection from level)
scan_conditions.notes: Tightened from 0.3 to 1.0 — ensures tradeable distance from pivot high

scan_conditions.name: had_close_below_8ema
scan_conditions.description: At some point in last 15 bars, close was below 8 EMA (confirms real pullback occurred)
scan_conditions.pcf: C1 < XAVGC8.1 OR C2 < XAVGC8.2 OR C3 < XAVGC8.3 OR C4 < XAVGC8.4 OR C5 < XAVGC8.5 OR C6 < XAVGC8.6 OR C7 < XAVGC8.7 OR C8 < XAVGC8.8 OR C9 < XAVGC8.9 OR C10 < XAVGC8.10 OR C11 < XAVGC8.11 OR C12 < XAVGC8.12 OR C13 < XAVGC8.13 OR C14 < XAVGC8.14 OR C15 < XAVGC8.15

scan_conditions.name: not_at_new_highs
scan_conditions.description: Prior 15-day high (starting 2 bars ago) is above the last 2 bars' high — bounce hasn't exceeded prior pivot

scan_conditions.name: extended_above_sma200
scan_conditions.description: Close at least 3 ATR above 200 SMA

scan_conditions.name: peak_ext50_30d
scan_conditions.description: 30-day high at least 30% of price above 50 SMA (confirms parabolic move)
scan_conditions.notes: Replaced ATR-based (3*ATR14) with %price scaling. Kills compression/grind stocks. REAL removed at 13.9%.

scan_conditions.name: retracement_cap
scan_conditions.description: Bounce has not retraced more than 67% of the high-to-low range
scan_conditions.notes: Using 0.7 in scan for buffer; all 15 examples below 0.67

scan_conditions.name: volume_below_average
scan_conditions.description: Signal day volume below 20-day average (weak bounce)

scan_conditions.name: high_near_ema8
scan_conditions.description: High not more than 1.1 ATR above EMA8 (no strong thrust)

scan_conditions.name: small_range
scan_conditions.description: Signal candle range under 1.1 ATR (weak candle)

scan_conditions.name: had_close_below_12ema
scan_conditions.description: Close was below 12 EMA at some point in last 15 bars (real pullback)
scan_conditions.pcf: C1 < XAVGC12.1 OR C2 < XAVGC12.2 OR C3 < XAVGC12.3 OR C4 < XAVGC12.4 OR C5 < XAVGC12.5 OR C6 < XAVGC12.6 OR C7 < XAVGC12.7 OR C8 < XAVGC12.8 OR C9 < XAVGC12.9 OR C10 < XAVGC12.10 OR C11 < XAVGC12.11 OR C12 < XAVGC12.12 OR C13 < XAVGC12.13 OR C14 < XAVGC12.14 OR C15 < XAVGC12.15

scan_conditions.name: not_too_far_from_high
scan_conditions.description: Price within 4.0 ATR of 30-day high (tradeable stop level exists)
scan_conditions.notes: Kills stocks where the spike is too far back to use as a reference level
